name: Cock Crowing
overview: The Scriptures use the crowing of the cock as a significant time marker associated with Jesus' prediction of Peter’s denial. Jesus foretold that Peter would deny Him three times before the cock crowed, a prophecy fulfilled as the cock crowed immediately after Peter’s denials, leading to Peter’s deep repentance (Matthew 26:34, 74-75; Mark 14:30, 68). Additionally, the cock crowing is mentioned as a recognized moment of watchfulness, symbolizing the need for vigilance because the exact time of the Lord’s coming is unknown (Mark 13:35). Together, these passages highlight both the fulfillment of Jesus’ foreknowledge and the call to spiritual alertness.
